verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Pipedream's managed, built-in authentication, where users connect accounts through Pipedream with no auth flow to build. Nothing in the pack shows custom branding of the authorization flow or bringing your own OAuth app client ID and secret. The line about connecting "right in your product" describes embedding managed auth, not white-labeling or using custom OAuth credentials, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can white-label the authorization flow with my own branding and my own OAuth app credentials
